region.title: Region
region.description: The tables' AWS region, such as us-east-1. Default: AWS_REGION where the connector runs, or the AWS default config's.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: A DynamoDB-compatible endpoint instead of the region's: a VPC endpoint, or DynamoDB Local's, such as http://127.0.0.1:8000.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials: an IAM role the destination names, or what the runner passes on.

secretAccessKey.title: Secret access key
secretAccessKey.description: The access key's secret. Needed with accessKeyId.

sessionToken.title: Session token
sessionToken.description: For temporary credentials from AWS STS: their session token, with their access key and secret.

tablePrefix.title: Table prefix
tablePrefix.description: Starts each table's name where the pipeline names no namespace, such as analytics_. With a namespace, a table is NAMESPACE.TABLE instead. The control table that stages rows and keeps each pipeline's fence is the prefix, or NAMESPACE., and _openetl_state.

x-groups.title: Credentials
x-groups.description: An access key, or else the AWS default credentials.
